chunks: We were told by Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ahmad ibn al-Walid, who said: We were told by Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from al-Abbas ibn Ma'ruf, from al-Hajjal, from Abdullah ibn Abi Hammad, who ascribed it to the Commander of the Believers (peace be upon him),
with regards to the saying of Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He: «the Lord of the Easts and the Wests»

He said: It has three hundred and sixty easts, and three hundred and sixty wests. Hence, on the day it appears in the east, it does not return to it except after a year, and the day it appears in the west, it does not return to it except after a year.

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Believers (title for Imam Ali)
key_terms.مَشَارِق: Easts (plural of mashriq, meaning places of sunrise)
key_terms.مَغَارِب: Wests (plural of maghrib, meaning places of sunset)

ai.seo_question: What does the Quranic phrase 'Easts and Wests' mean according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Ma'ani al-Akhbar*, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) elucidates the Quranic phrase 'the Easts and the Wests' by specifying 360 distinct points for sunrise and sunset, reflecting the ancient astronomical understanding of the solar year. This interpretation highlights the precision of divine revelation in describing natural phenomena, affirming the sun's cyclical journey which completes its return to the same point only after a full year.

en.basel-kadem: 1.	We were told by Muhammed bin Hasan bin Ahmad bin Waleed, that he said: We were told by Muhammed bin Hasan al-Saffar, from Abbas bin Ma’ruf, from Hajjal, from Abdullah bin Abi Hammad, that he ascribed it to the Commander of the Believers, peace be upon him,
with regards to the saying of Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He: «the Lord of the Easts and the Wests» [70:40].

He said: It has three hundred and sixty easts, and three hundred and sixty wests. Hence, on the day it appears in the east, it does not return to it except after a year, and the day it appears in the west, it does not return to it except after a year.
